items.title: Ken Peplowski interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...you could hum the tune to The Dick VanDyke Show. [INTERVIEWEE] Of course, all those old things, yeah.

ctx.x: That’s right. In fact Steve Allen, you know the piano player? He was telling me, he was talking about this very thing. And he said, “I defy you to hum back the tune to the new Tonight Show.” I can’t think of it.
That’s true. And you see that in some of the T.V. shows too. You know I bet if I asked you, you could hum the tune to The Dick VanDyke Show.
Of course, all those old things, yeah.
